name: Steeltooth Bar
description: The private network behind a Tyger Claws bar in Watson: the cameras, the alarm and the back-room ledger. Overclock can jack in from the booth by the toilets.

nodes.label: Control Node (Cameras)
nodes.note: Every camera in the bar and the alley out back. Loop the feed and the crew walks in unseen.

nodes.label: Liche, Raven
nodes.note: Two Black ICE on one floor: the Liche and a Raven activate together.
The back-room ledger: who owes the bar, and which Tyger Claws collect. Leverage on the owner.

nodes.label: Control Node (Alarm)
nodes.note: Trips the alarm, or keeps it quiet. Tripped, four bouncers come running.
Guards the bottom floor whichever way the Netrunner comes down.
